scope: Local experimental scalability validation; no server benchmark; no Git operations.

environment.method: One warm-up then four warm runs in the same JVM; separate frozen builds, sequential workloads. Cold-only/timeout runs are explicitly labelled.
environment.timing_scope: PLANAR/DEPTH wall_ms is the complete CLI calculation, output writing and independent verification. It excludes HTTP upload, DB queueing and application startup.
environment.memory: Linux /proc/self/status VmRSS and MemoryMXBean heap sampled every 10 ms; retained_heap_after_parse is whole JVM used heap after System.gc, including parser/runtime objects. Sampling is not an exact allocation bound.
environment.metrics_scope: routing_intersection_calls counts instrumented robust overlays in routing obstacle spaces, not every JTS call in the process.

hypotheses.decision: KEEP compact XY storage and deferred preparation; REJECT dropping input geometries by a fixed ROI
hypotheses.reason: All geometries remain available to checks/validation. Plain JTS packed storage with a Coordinate[] soft cache increased retained heap and was replaced by an uncached packed sequence.

hypotheses.decision: KEEP bounded navigation construction with adaptive expansion
hypotheses.reason: Navigation candidates are selected locally; the full obstacle index checks every route. Initial region includes all consumers, existing lines and chambers. Failed attachment expands coverage within explicit resource budgets.

Independent cluster networks fail combined validation. Reordering clusters with global topology can improve score on some synthetic scenes but adds work; measurements are retained, not promoted to a scalable replacement.
Independent path-length witnesses A/B/C pass both the calculator and output validator; parallel branches are not summed and constant-flow diameter is preserved.

hypotheses.decision: KEEP explicit per-feature and accumulated-model admission budgets
hypotheses.reason: File bytes and routing complexity are measured separately. Resource exhaustion raises COMPLEXITY_LIMIT, not geometric impossibility or silent filtering.

confirmed_experimental_defects.case: 6 km water barrier and remote park; independently validated 6.35 km witness
confirmed_experimental_defects.before: Global search connected; initial local expansion stopped at 5624 > 4096 grid cells.
confirmed_experimental_defects.fix: Use the primary 100000-cell budget for region expansion, retain the 4096-cell budget for optional fine refinement.

confirmed_experimental_defects.case: The same long detour raises DU to 900 by continuous length
confirmed_experimental_defects.before: Adaptive candidate used SMALL clearance: 1.70 m from water versus 2.23 m required. Its rejection hid the class-upgrade request.
confirmed_experimental_defects.fix: Keep rejecting the invalid candidate, forward affected consumer class floors to the existing rerouting loop, and validate the rerouted forest again.

manifest.json.provenance: Synthetic translations/scaling of frozen OSM road polygons; not real city positions.

large-simple-manifest.json.purpose: Byte-size control: unchanged geometries, unused text; NOT a complex city geometry fixture.

remaining_limits: The whole retained input model and full obstacle index still reside in heap; this is not out-of-core geometry storage.
A city-wide existing heat network or widely separated consumers also enlarge the initial navigation region; this case is not solved by discarding remote tie-ins.
Adaptive expansion has finite vertex/edge/visibility/grid budgets. COMPLEXITY_LIMIT is not proof of unreachability.
Admission estimates reserve memory but cannot guarantee that every JTS operation on adversarial geometry stays below heap. No promise of arbitrary 3 GB geometry complexity.
City objects use real OSM shapes translated/scaled to synthetic positions. Their local consumers remain the original 17; this is not a million-consumer benchmark.
The 500-consumer dense scene reached the existing 50000000 visibility-check budget; no cluster result is claimed for it.
Region expansion is triggered by a failed attachment; it does not exhaust every possible cost-improving route outside a region that already has a valid connection.
The large-simple file contains unused text deliberately; it demonstrates byte-size independence, not large geometric complexity.
